content.text: Scout (agents/scout/scout.py) is our Lumen docs assistant. The docs team is moving every page under a versioned folder, agents/scout/docs/v2/<slug>.md, and the move lands this week. Get Scout ready ahead of it: add a doc_root release setting (default 'docs', relative to agents/scout) and make read_doc load pages from <doc_root>/<slug>.md for the active release. Leave the search index as it is for now. Ship it as a new release agents/scout/releases/s3.yaml (copy s2, doc_root: docs/v2, a fitting title). Don't edit s1/s2. Sanity-check with: uv run --project backend python agents/scout/scout.py eval --release s3 (run it from the repo root), then commit only the files you changed with a clear message.

1	"""Scout: the docs Q&A assistant for Lumen, a (fictional) product analytics SaaS.
2	
3	Scout is an ordinary customer agent. It knows nothing about Night Shift's internals: it is traced by
4	neatlogs, reads its release, model and limits through the Night Shift SDK, reports deploys and graded
5	outcomes, and runs verification replays when Night Shift asks.
6	
7	    python scout.py ask "How many steps can a funnel have?"
8	    python scout.py serve --rate 6          # live traffic + replay worker
9	    python scout.py deploy s2               # report a deploy (commit = last change to the release)
10	    python scout.py eval --release s2       # offline eval over the question bank
11	"""
12	
13	from __future__ import annotations
14	
15	import argparse
16	import json
17	import logging
18	import os
19	import random
20	import re
21	import subprocess
22	import sys
23	import time
24	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
25	from pathlib import Path
26	from typing import Any, Callable
27	
28	import yaml
29	
30	HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
31	DOCS_DIR = HERE / "docs"
32	RELEASES_DIR = HERE / "releases"
33	DEFAULT_RELEASE = "s1"
34	WORKFLOW = "scout-answers"
35	ROOT_SPAN = "scout_answer"
36	REPLAY_SPAN = "scout_replay"  # evals and verification replays: traced, but not live traffic
37	# A wrong answer becomes a support ticket and some churn risk; an escalation is just the ticket.
38	VALUE_FAILED_USD = 6.0
39	VALUE_ESCALATED_USD = 4.5
40	
41	log = logging.getLogger("scout")
42	
43	STOPWORDS = set("""a an and are as at be by can do does for from get go has have how i if in is it its
44	me my of on or our past so that the their them there this to us was we what when where which who why
45	will with you your much many long any does doesn't don't lose""".split())
46	
47	
48	# -- releases ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
49	@dataclass
50	class Release:
51	    id: str
52	    title: str
53	    model: str
54	    retriever: str = "v1"
55	    top_k: int = 3
56	    max_steps: int = 6
57	    system_prompt: str = ""
58	    extra: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
59	
60	
61	def load_release(release_id: str) -> Release:
62	    path = RELEASES_DIR / f"{release_id}.yaml"
63	    if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9_-]+", release_id) or not path.exists():
64	        raise KeyError(f"unknown release {release_id!r}")
65	    raw = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text())
66	    known = {k: raw.pop(k) for k in list(raw) if k in Release.__dataclass_fields__ and k != "extra"}
67	    return Release(**known, extra=raw)
68	
69	
70	# -- docs index ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
71	class ToolError(RuntimeError):
72	    pass
73	
74	
75	def tokens(text: str) -> list[str]:
76	    return [t for t in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9$]+", text.lower()) if t not in STOPWORDS and len(t) > 1]
77	
78	
79	@dataclass
80	class Section:
81	    slug: str
82	    title: str
83	    heading: str
84	    text: str
85	
86	
87	class DocIndex:
88	    def __init__(self, docs_dir: Path = DOCS_DIR):
89	        self.docs: dict[str, str] = {}
90	        self.titles: dict[str, str] = {}
91	        self.sections: list[Section] = []
92	        for path in sorted(docs_dir.glob("*.md")):
93	            slug, body = path.stem, path.read_text()
94	            self.docs[slug] = body
95	            title, heading, buf = slug, "", []
96	            for line in body.splitlines() + ["## "]:
97	                if line.startswith("# "):
98	                    title = line[2:].strip()
99	                elif line.startswith("## "):
100	                    if buf:
101	                        self.sections.append(Section(slug, title, heading, " ".join(buf).strip()))
102	                    heading, buf = line[3:].strip(), []
103	                elif line.strip():
104	                    buf.append(line.strip())
105	            self.titles[slug] = title
106	
107	    def search_v1(self, query: str, k: int = 3) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
108	        """Full-text section search: query terms scored against heading (x2) and body."""
109	        q = set(tokens(query))
110	        scored = []
111	        for s in self.sections:
112	            head, body = tokens(f"{s.title} {s.heading}"), tokens(s.text)
113	            score = sum(2 for t in head if t in q) + sum(1 for t in body if t in q)
114	            if score:
115	                scored.append((score, s))
116	        scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])
117	        return [{"slug": s.slug, "title": s.title, "section": s.heading, "snippet": s.text[:240]}
118	                for _, s in scored[:k]]
119	
120	    def search_v2(self, query: str, k: int = 2) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
121	        """Title/heading search: query terms scored against page titles and section headings only."""
122	        q = set(tokens(query))
123	        scored = []
124	        for s in self.sections:
125	            score = sum(1 for t in tokens(f"{s.title} {s.heading}") if t in q)
126	            if score:
127	                scored.append((score, s))
128	        scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])
129	        return [{"slug": s.slug, "title": s.title, "section": s.heading, "snippet": s.text[:240]}
130	                for _, s in scored[:k]]
131	
132	    def search(self, query: str, k: int, retriever: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
133	        fn: Callable[[str, int], list[dict[str, Any]]] | None = getattr(self, f"search_{retriever}", None)
134	        if fn is None:
135	            raise ToolError(f"retriever {retriever!r} is not available")
136	        return fn(query, k)
137	
138	    def read_doc(self, slug: str) -> str:
139	        if slug not in self.docs:
140	            raise ToolError(f"doc not found: {slug!r}")
141	        return self.docs[slug]
142	
143	
144	INDEX = DocIndex()
145	
146	TOOLS = [
147	    {"type": "function", "function": {
148	        "name": "search_docs", "description": "Search the Lumen docs. Returns matching sections with slugs.",
149	        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"query": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["query"]}}},
150	    {"type": "function", "function": {
151	        "name": "read_doc", "description": "Read a full Lumen docs page by slug (from search_docs).",
152	        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"slug": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["slug"]}}},
153	]
154	
155	
156	# -- grading ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
157	def _bank() -> dict[str, list[list[str]]]:
158	    return {q["q"]: q["must"] for q in yaml.safe_load((HERE / "questions.yaml").read_text())}
159	
160	
161	BANK = _bank()
162	NOT_FOUND = re.compile(r"could not find|couldn't find|not covered|contact support|support@lumen", re.I)
163	
164	
165	def grade(question: str, answer: str, error: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:
166	    """ok | failed | escalated, with a short note."""
167	    if error or not answer.strip():
168	        return "failed", error or "empty answer"
169	    must = BANK.get(question)
170	    if must is None:  # a question outside the bank: only judge whether Scout answered
171	        return ("escalated", "deferred to support") if NOT_FOUND.search(answer) else ("ok", "answered")
172	    low = answer.lower()
173	    missing = [g[0] for g in must if not any(alt.lower() in low for alt in g)]
174	    if not missing:
175	        return "ok", "all required facts present"
176	    if NOT_FOUND.search(answer):
177	        return "escalated", f"deferred to support; missing {missing}"
178	    return "failed", f"missing {missing}"
179	
180	
181	# -- the agent ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
182	@dataclass
183	class Result:
184	    answer: str = ""
185	    steps: int = 0
186	    tool_errors: int = 0
187	    tokens: int = 0
188	    error: str | None = None
189	    tool_log: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
190	
191	
192	def _trace(name: str, kind: str):
193	    import neatlogs
194	
195	    return neatlogs.trace(name, kind=kind)
196	
197	
198	def run_tool(name: str, args: dict[str, Any], release: Release, res: Result) -> Any:
199	    """Each tool call is its own neatlogs span; a raised ToolError marks the span as errored."""
200	    try:
201	        with _trace(f"tool.{name}", "TOOL") as span:
202	            _set(span, **{"input.value": json.dumps(args)})
203	            if name == "search_docs":
204	                out: Any = INDEX.search(str(args.get("query", "")), release.top_k, release.retriever)
205	            elif name == "read_doc":
206	                out = INDEX.read_doc(str(args.get("slug", "")))[:4000]
207	            else:
208	                raise ToolError(f"unknown tool {name}")
209	            _set(span, **{"output.value": json.dumps(out)[:2000]})
210	    except ToolError as exc:
211	        res.tool_errors += 1
212	        out = {"error": str(exc)}
213	    res.tool_log.append({"tool": name, "args": args, "hits": len(out) if isinstance(out, list) else None,
214	                         "error": out.get("error") if isinstance(out, dict) else None})
215	    return out
216	
217	
218	def _brain() -> str:
219	    return os.environ.get("SCOUT_BRAIN") or ("live" if os.environ.get("LITELLM_API_KEY") else "sim")
220	
221	
222	def answer_live(question: str, release: Release, model: str, max_steps: int, tools_enabled: bool) -> Result:
223	    from openai import OpenAI
224	    import neatlogs
225	
226	    client = neatlogs.wrap(OpenAI(base_url=os.environ.get("LITELLM_BASE_URL"), api_key=os.environ["LITELLM_API_KEY"],
227	                                  timeout=60, max_retries=1))
228	    res = Result()
229	    messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = [{"role": "system", "content": release.system_prompt},
230	                                      {"role": "user", "content": question}]
231	    for step in range(max_steps):
232	        res.steps = step + 1
233	        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {"model": model, "messages": messages, "max_tokens": 400, "temperature": 0.1}
234	        if tools_enabled and step < max_steps - 1:
235	            kwargs["tools"] = TOOLS
236	        for attempt in range(4):
237	            try:
238	                resp = client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
239	                break
240	            except Exception as exc:  # gateway rate limit: back off
241	                if getattr(exc, "status_code", None) == 429 and attempt < 3:
242	                    time.sleep(4 * (attempt + 1))
243	                    continue
244	                res.error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:200]}"
245	                return res
246	        res.tokens += getattr(resp.usage, "total_tokens", 0) or 0
247	        msg = resp.choices[0].message
248	        if not msg.tool_calls:
249	            res.answer = msg.content or ""
250	            return res
251	        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": msg.content or "",
252	                         "tool_calls": [tc.model_dump() for tc in msg.tool_calls]})
253	        for tc in msg.tool_calls:
254	            try:
255	                args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments or "{}")
256	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
257	                args = {}
258	            out = run_tool(tc.function.name, args, release, res)
259	            messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc.id, "content": json.dumps(out)[:4000]})
260	    res.error = f"ran out of steps ({max_steps})"
261	    return res
262	
263	
264	def answer_sim(question: str, release: Release, model: str, max_steps: int, tools_enabled: bool) -> Result:
265	    """Deterministic, offline brain for tests: search, read the best page, quote the best sentences."""
266	    res = Result(steps=1)
267	    if not tools_enabled:
268	        res.answer = "I could not find that in the Lumen docs. Please contact [REDACTED_EMAIL]."
269	        return res
270	    hits = run_tool("search_docs", {"query": question}, release, res)
271	    res.steps += 1
272	    if not isinstance(hits, list) or not hits:
273	        res.answer = "I could not find that in the Lumen docs. Please contact [REDACTED_EMAIL]."
274	        return res
275	    page = run_tool("read_doc", {"slug": hits[0]["slug"]}, release, res)
276	    res.steps += 1
277	    if isinstance(page, dict):
278	        res.answer = "I could not find that in the Lumen docs. Please contact [REDACTED_EMAIL]."
279	        return res
280	    q = set(tokens(question))
281	    snippets = " ".join(h["snippet"] for h in hits)
282	    sentences = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", snippets)
283	    best = sorted(sentences, key=lambda s: -len(q & set(tokens(s))))[:2]
284	    res.answer = " ".join(best)
285	    res.tokens = 600
286	    return res
287	
288	
289	def _set(span: Any, **attrs: Any) -> None:
290	    for k, v in attrs.items():
291	        if v is None:
292	            continue
293	        try:
294	            span.set_attribute(k, v if isinstance(v, (str, int, float, bool)) else str(v))
295	        except Exception:
296	            pass
297	
298	
299	def _trace_id(span: Any) -> str | None:
300	    try:
301	        ctx = span.get_span_context()
302	        return format(ctx.trace_id, "032x") if ctx and ctx.trace_id else None
303	    except Exception:
304	        return None
305	
306	
307	_tracing = False
308	
309	
310	def init_tracing() -> None:
311	    global _tracing
312	    if _tracing:
313	        return
314	    import neatlogs
315	
316	    key = os.environ.get("SCOUT_NEATLOGS_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")
317	    neatlogs.init(api_key=key or None, workflow_name=WORKFLOW, tags=["app:scout"], disable_export=not key,
318	                  register_shutdown_handlers=True)
319	    _tracing = True
320	
321	
322	def handle(question: str, ns: Any, replay: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
323	    """Answer one question on whatever Night Shift says is live, and report the graded outcome."""
324	    init_tracing()
325	    try:
326	        release = load_release(ns.release(DEFAULT_RELEASE))
327	    except KeyError:
328	        release = load_release(DEFAULT_RELEASE)
329	    model = ns.model(release.model)
330	    max_steps = ns.max_steps(release.max_steps)
331	    tools_enabled = ns.flag("tools_enabled", True)
332	    brain = answer_live if _brain() == "live" else answer_sim
333	    started = time.time()
334	    with _trace(REPLAY_SPAN if replay else ROOT_SPAN, "WORKFLOW") as span:
335	        _set(span, **{"neatlogs.workflow_name": WORKFLOW, "input.value": question, "scout.release": release.id,
336	                      "scout.model": model, "scout.replay": replay})
337	        trace_id = _trace_id(span)
338	        res = brain(question, release, model, max_steps, tools_enabled)
339	        outcome, note = grade(question, res.answer, res.error)
340	        _set(span, **{"output.value": res.answer or res.error or "", "scout.outcome": outcome,
341	                      "scout.grade_note": note, "scout.tool_errors": res.tool_errors})
342	        if res.error:
343	            try:
344	                from opentelemetry.trace import Status, StatusCode
345	
346	                span.set_status(Status(StatusCode.ERROR, res.error[:200]))
347	            except Exception:
348	                pass
349	    value = VALUE_FAILED_USD if outcome == "failed" else VALUE_ESCALATED_USD if outcome == "escalated" else 0.0
350	    if not replay:
351	        ns.record(outcome, trace_id=trace_id, value_usd=value, release=release.id, model=model, note=note)
352	    return {"trace_id": trace_id, "release": release.id, "model": model, "outcome": outcome, "note": note,
353	            "answer": res.answer, "error": res.error, "steps": res.steps, "tool_errors": res.tool_errors,
354	            "tools": res.tool_log, "latency_s": round(time.time() - started, 2)}
355	
356	
357	# -- CLI ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
358	def _ns():
359	    from nightshift_sdk import NightShift
360	
361	    return NightShift()
362	
363	
364	class _Pinned:
365	    """Stand-in for the SDK that pins a release (offline eval)."""
366	
367	    def __init__(self, release: str):
368	        self._r = release
369	
370	    def release(self, default: str) -> str:
371	        return self._r
372	
373	    def model(self, default: str) -> str:
374	        return default
375	
376	    def max_steps(self, default: int) -> int:
377	        return default
378	
379	    def flag(self, name: str, default: bool = True) -> bool:
380	        return default
381	
382	    def record(self, *a: Any, **k: Any) -> bool:
383	        return False
384	
385	
386	def git_commit_for(release: str) -> str | None:
387	    out = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%H", "--", f"releases/{release}.yaml"], cwd=HERE,
388	                         capture_output=True, text=True)
389	    return out.stdout.strip() or None
390	
391	
392	def load_env() -> None:
393	    env = HERE.parents[1] / ".env"
394	    if env.exists():
395	        for line in env.read_text().splitlines():
396	            if "=" in line and not line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
397	                k, v = line.split("=", 1)
398	                os.environ.setdefault(k.strip(), v.strip().strip('"'))
399	
400	
401	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
402	    load_env()
403	    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s scout %(message)s")
404	    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="scout")
405	    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
406	    a = sub.add_parser("ask")
407	    a.add_argument("question")
408	    s = sub.add_parser("serve")
409	    s.add_argument("--rate", type=float, default=6.0, help="questions per minute")
410	    s.add_argument("--count", type=int, default=0, help="stop after N questions (0 = forever)")
411	    d = sub.add_parser("deploy")
412	    d.add_argument("release")
413	    d.add_argument("--actor", default="ci")
414	    e = sub.add_parser("eval")
415	    e.add_argument("--release", default=DEFAULT_RELEASE)
416	    args = p.parse_args(argv)
417	
418	    if args.cmd == "ask":
419	        print(json.dumps(handle(args.question, _ns()), indent=2))
420	    elif args.cmd == "deploy":
421	        rel = load_release(args.release)
422	        ns = _ns()
423	        ok = ns.report_deploy(rel.id, commit=git_commit_for(rel.id), actor=args.actor, default_model=rel.model)
424	        print(f"deploy {rel.id} reported: {ok}")
425	        return 0 if ok else 1
426	    elif args.cmd == "eval":
427	        ns = _Pinned(args.release)
428	        rows = [handle(q, ns, replay=True) for q in BANK]
429	        good = sum(r["outcome"] == "ok" for r in rows)
430	        for q, r in zip(BANK, rows):
431	            print(f"{r['outcome']:9} {q[:60]:60} {r['note']}")
432	        print(f"\n{args.release}: {good}/{len(rows)} correct")
433	    elif args.cmd == "serve":
434	        ns = _ns()
435	        ns.serve_replays(lambda q: (lambda r: {"ok": r["outcome"] == "ok", "output": r["answer"],
436	                                               "trace_id": r["trace_id"]})(handle(q, ns, replay=True)))
437	        questions, n = list(BANK), 0
438	        while not args.count or n < args.count:
439	            r = handle(random.choice(questions), ns)
440	            n += 1
441	            log.info("%s %s %s/%s %s", r["release"], r["outcome"], r["steps"], r["tool_errors"], r["note"])
442	            time.sleep(max(0.5, 60.0 / args.rate - r["latency_s"]))
443	        ns.close()
444	    return 0
445	
446	
447	if __name__ == "__main__":
448	    sys.exit(main())

content.text:
Scout now has a `doc_root` setting and a new `s3` release that reads pages from `docs/v2`. The `s3` eval scores 15/18, because `docs/v2` doesn't exist yet. `s2` still scores 18/18. I committed as `c42532d`, with only `scout.py` and `releases/s3.yaml`.

- **`scout.py`:** `Release` has a `doc_root` field, default `docs`, relative to `agents/scout`. `read_doc` loads `<doc_root>/<slug>.md` for the active release. The search index still builds from `docs/`, as you asked.
- **Slug check I added:** `read_doc` only accepts plain slugs (letters, digits, `_`, `-`). That stops a model-supplied slug from reading files outside the doc root.
- **`s3.yaml`:** a copy of `s2` with `id: s3`, the title "Scout lean retrieval - pages read from versioned docs/v2", and `doc_root: docs/v2`. I didn't touch `s1` or `s2`.

**Eval:** the 3 `s3` misses come from `read_doc` failing for lack of `docs/v2`. The run used the live model, not the offline brain, because `LITELLM_API_KEY` is set. The three misses showed up as `escalated`, and the two I saw were the free-plan event cap and the annual refund. The other 15 passed from search snippets alone. Once the docs team lands the move, re-run `uv run --project backend python agents/scout/scout.py eval --release s3`. It should go back to 18/18.

**Search index:** it still comes from `docs/`. When the pages move, `docs/*.md` will be gone and the index will have nothing to search. Pointing the index at the same `doc_root` is a small follow-up.

I didn't run `deploy s3`.
